output.summary: The problem is that recent changes to billing import validation rules cause systematic mis-billing of meter reads, leading to increased dispute tickets. This was established by observing that dispute tickets rose from 590 in July to 1260 in September (E-03) and that disputed bills are higher for actual reads than estimated reads (E-01), showing the surge is not driven by estimate substitution. Further analysis of AMI reads revealed many were rejected for high consumption (E-12), indicating rule‑change related mis‑billing. No work items were released; the release decision was HOLD, so the planned items audit_billing_import_rules:DA-RULES, fix_billing_rule_defects:billing-db, and monitor_dispute_volume:DA-TICKET remain pending (release.decision HOLD, hold list). The release was held because the verification obligation VOB-U-U3—whether correcting the rule defects will reduce dispute volume to the pre‑August baseline—is still open (status OPEN), blocking release, and the gate resulted in CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs (verification_obligations.VOB-U-U3 status OPEN; release.hold includes VOB-U-U3; release.limitations). Known limitations include the gate limitation that deferred items are tracked as VOBs (DEFINE Gate CONDITIONAL_PASS) and open unknowns about whether the mis‑billing affects specific read types or tariffs (U-U2 status OPEN) and whether correcting the rule defects will reduce dispute volume (U-U3 status DEFERRED).
key_points: Problem: Recent changes to billing import validation rules cause systematic mis-billing of meter reads, leading to increased dispute tickets (problem_definition.evidence_refs: E-03, E-01).
Establishment: Dispute tickets rose from 590 in July to 1260 in September (E-03); disputed bills higher for actual than estimated reads (E-01); AMI reads rejected for high consumption (E-12).
Released: No items released; release decision HOLD holds audit_billing_import_rules:DA-RULES, fix_billing_rule_defects:billing-db, monitor_dispute_volume:DA-TICKET (release.decision HOLD, hold list).

Decision reason: Held due to open VOB-U-U3 (whether correcting rule defects will reduce dispute volume to baseline) blocking release; gate CONDITIONAL_PASS (verification_obligations.VOB-U-U3 status OPEN; release.hold includes VOB-U-U3; release.limitations).

Limitations: Gate limitation notes deferred items tracked as VOBs (DEFINE Gate CONDITIONAL_PASS); unknowns U-U2 open (mis‑billing effect on read types/tariffs) and U-U3 deferred (effect of correction on dispute volume) (release.limitations; unknowns.U-U2 status OPEN; unknowns.U-U3 status DEFERRED).
limitations_explained: Gate limitation: deferred items are tracked as VOBs (DEFINE Gate CONDITIONAL_PASS) (release.limitations).
